content.value: Suppose you have a memory chip where each word has 32 bits and the total number of rows (12) are equal to the number of rows of a N MB memory. Now draw the complete memory chip by showing the size of address lines and data lines. Here,

$$
N { = } ( \mathrm { l a s t d i g i t o f { y o u r r o l l n u m b e r } } \% 2 ) + 1 .
$$
